meta.model_frame: FlightGear c172p Models/c172-common.ac (commit 84477612): meters, +x aft, +y up, +z left; FG pitch offset -3 deg about the JSBSim VRP (34, 0, 35.75 in). See c172p-systems.json frames.transform.

what_the_manual_defines.summary: Figure 1-2 "Reference Stations" (PDF pp. 14-15, manual pp. 1-4/1-5) gives fuselage stations (side view) and wing stations (standard wing, sheet 1; wet wing beginning 1981, sheet 2) only. There is NO water line or buttock line diagram anywhere in the manual. The only waterline statement is Fig 2-2 / para 2-5: the two longitudinal leveling screws on the left side of the tailcone are "at zero waterline". No numeric datum definition sentence is printed; FS 0.00 is drawn at the firewall.
what_the_manual_defines.para_1_5: STATIONS. Station diagrams are shown in figure 1-2 to assist in locating equipment when a written description is inadequate or impractical. (PDF p11, manual p1-1)

FS.definition: Fuselage station, inches, positive aft. FS 0.00 is drawn at the firewall (front face of firewall: E/C/F groups place firewall-mounted parts at FS 0.00).
FS.confidence: read from drawing (Fig 1-2 p14); the "front face" wording is the Cessna POH weight-and-balance datum convention, not printed in this manual

WS.definition: Wing station, inches, measured outboard along the wing from the airplane centreline; root rib WS 23.62 (standard) / 22.875 (wet wing), tip rib WS 208.00.
WS.confidence: read from drawing (Fig 1-2); measurement origin (centreline) inferred from root rib WS 23.62 lying at the fuselage side (AC fuselage half-width at wing root 20.4 in)

BL.definition: Buttock line, inches from the plane of symmetry. NOT DEFINED IN THIS MANUAL. Adopted convention here: BL 0 = airplane centreline (Fig 5-6 plumb-bob alignment uses centreline points: tail tie-down ring and the inspection cover screw aft of the nose gear, p193); signed BL positive RIGHT (starboard), negative left, to match the JSBSim structural y axis. Write LBL/RBL in words.

WL.definition: Water line, inches, positive up. Only WL 0 is defined: the two leveling screws on the left side of the tailcone (Fig 2-2 p38, para 2-5 p40). No numeric WL is printed for any other feature.
WL.confidence: stated in text (definition); its height in the AC model is estimated

zero_height_estimate.method: Fig 2-2 drawing: screw A1 just aft of baggage door at ~FS 112, ~0.46 of the local fuselage depth below the top; screw A2 at ~FS 155, ~0.65 below the top. Mapped onto the AC fuselage profile at those FS: struct z 26.0 and 21.8; mean used. The drawing is not to scale, so treat WL values as +/-3 in.

datum_and_axes.level_attitude: Longitudinal level = the two tailcone screws level; lateral level = corresponding points on both upper door sills (para 2-5). The WL axis is taken parallel to JSBSim structural z (no pitch correction fitted: FS fit points span only 9-41 in of height, too little to resolve a pitch difference).

wet_wing_1981_on.notes: Fig 1-2 sheet 2 ("Wet wing option beginning with 1981 model year"). Leading-edge stations 23.65-100.00 are labelled along the LE; 22.875 root rib (fuel-bay transmitter on root rib); 65.125 integral bay outboard limit (no skin repairs inboard, p492).

wing_stations.twist: Washout 3 deg 00 min between WS 100.50 and 208.00; no twist root to WS 100.50 (para 18-8, Fig 18-2 p506). Stabilizer incidence -3 deg 30 min.

transform.description: Cessna stations (inches) -> AC3D model meters. Step 1: Cessna -> JSBSim structural inches: x = FS + dx, y = BL (signed, + right), z = WL + z0. Step 2: c172p-systems.json frames.transform (structural -> AC; VRP origin, undo -3 deg pitch, axes (x, z, -y)).

fitted_parameters.dx_fit: least squares over 4 FS correspondences (R1-R4); residual rms 0.55 in
fitted_parameters.free_scale_check: fitting FS scale too gives k = 0.99793, dx = 0.66 in (residuals -0.12, 0.78, -0.68, 0.01) - scale 1 retained
fitted_parameters.z0: estimated from the tailcone leveling screws (see datum_and_axes.WL); +/-3 in

transform.wing_and_tail_lateral_note: The AC model is not to Cessna scale laterally. Wing: nav-light tip at BL 222.8 vs 216.5 (433.00/2) -> ratio 1.029 at the tip; the AC outer-panel joint (aileron inboard end) at BL 103.0 vs strut station WS 100.50 (ratio 1.025). Recommended for placing wing hardware on the AC wing: BL_ac = 1.025 * WS (residuals: WS 100.50 -> 103.0 = 0.0; WS 208.00 -> 213.2 vs AC LE-panel end 215.1; tip 216.5 -> 221.9 vs 222.8). Horizontal tail: AC tip 69.7 vs 67.57 -> scale 1.031 for stabilizer hardware. Main gear: AC wheels at BL +/-43.9 vs manual +/-50.18 (AC track 87.8 in vs 100.36 in, ratio 0.875): place wheel/brake/axle hardware relative to the AC wheel objects, not by manual BL.
